findings.current: in-force
findings.proposed: in-force only for vehicles first supplied before 1 Oct 2006; superseded by ADR 83/00 for new vehicles
findings.evidence: WebSearch: "ADR 28/01 has been superseded by ADR 83/… for new vehicles as from 1 October 2006." (record has no note of this; ADR 83/00 record au-f2005l03523 is the current new-vehicle standard)

findings.proposed: UN R24 (diesel smoke); drop R83/R168
findings.evidence: WebSearch (dieselnet/transportpolicy): "The smoke standard adopts UN ECE R24/03 and allows the US EPA 98 smoke standards as an alternative." ADR 30/01 is smoke opacity, not R83 pollutant emissions or R168.

findings.proposed: none (static door crush test; FMVSS 214 static is the accepted alternative). UN R95 corresponds to ADR 72/00 dynamic side impact
findings.evidence: WebSearch: ADR 29/00 treats "FMVSS 214-35 ... Side Door Strength - Passenger Cars" S5-S7 as equivalent; "ADR 72/00 is the Australian standard corresponding to UN ECE R95". Record TOC: "DETERMINATION OF CRUSH RESISTANCE".

findings.proposed: UN R137 only
findings.evidence: ADR 69/00 is Full Frontal Impact; UN R94 is the offset deformable barrier regulation (counterpart of ADR 73/00 Offset Frontal Impact, record au-f2005l03990). UN R137 is the full-width frontal regulation.

findings.proposed: UN R21 (interior fittings / instrument panel impact)
findings.evidence: ADR 21/00 Instrument Panel is the occupant-impact standard for the instrument panel; UN R121 covers location/identification of controls, tell-tales and indicators (counterpart of ADR 18/03). Tag "Tell-tales & controls" also questionable.

findings.proposed: UN R53 (installation of lighting on L3 motorcycles); R48 is for M/N/O categories only
findings.evidence: ADR 19/02 title: "Installation of Lighting and Light Signalling Devices on L-Group Vehicles"; UN R48 scope is categories M, N, O (cf. ADR 13/00 "other than L-Group", which maps to R48). Commodity tags Wiring/Connectors unsupported by body/title.

findings.proposed: UN R48 (installation); R148 is a device specification, not installation
findings.evidence: ADR 13/00 is an installation standard; UN R148 specifies light-signalling devices, not their installation. Note June 2026 lighting package amends ADR 13/00 to add alternative pathways (WebSearch igarr.com).

findings.current: ['Exhaust','Horn']
findings.proposed: Exhaust (and Intake/Muffler if in taxonomy); remove Horn
findings.evidence: ADR 83/00 is vehicle external (pass-by) noise; the body has no horn content (horn is a separate instrument). Also systems tag "Emissions" is unsupported: noise is already tagged "Noise".

findings.current: requires vehicles to comply with external noise limits
findings.proposed: Add scope (M/N and L-group categories) only if text is obtained
findings.evidence: Body has only the table-of-contents link "Text"; summary is derived from the title, nothing in the file supports specific limits.

findings.current: gas discharge headlamps ... national design requirements
findings.evidence: Body has only a single "Text" link in the TOC; summary derived from title alone.

findings.current: ['Braking','EMC']
findings.proposed: Braking, Lighting & signaling (electrical installation); drop EMC
findings.evidence: Body TOC: "ELECTRICAL REQUIREMENTS", "BRAKING SYSTEM". Electrical requirements are wiring/connection installation for road-train vehicles, not electromagnetic compatibility.

findings.proposed: UN R121 and UN R39 (speedometer/odometer); drop Infotainment commodity
findings.evidence: ADR 18/03 Instrumentation covers speedometer/odometer and instrument display; R39 is the speedometer/odometer regulation. "Infotainment" tag unsupported.

findings.proposed: UN R57 (and R72) motorcycle headlamps; R112/R113 are car headlamp regulations
findings.evidence: ADR 55/00 Headlamps for Motor Cycles; UN R57 is the dedicated headlamps-for-motorcycles regulation.

findings.proposed: UN R50 (L-category position/stop lamps) and UN R6 (indicators); R48 is for M/N/O installation
findings.evidence: ADR 53/00 covers devices (position, stop, indicator, plate lamps) for L-group vehicles; R48 does not apply to L-category.

notes: Systemic: all 34 records are legislation.gov.au page scrapes (header, status paragraph, TOC links) with no regulation text, so every summary is derived from titles/TOC and cannot be checked against real requirements; the UI should not call these full text. AI-suggested un_equivalent_ai is the weakest field in this shard (wrong for ADR 30/01, 29/00, 69/00, 21/00, 19/02). Many records have no un_equivalent_ai where an obvious counterpart exists (ADR 6/00 R6, 8/01 R43, 48/00 R4, 52/00 R38, 77/00 R98, 47 R3, 58/00 R107); not listed individually. Titles, citations, ids and status (header 'In force') matched the instruments; ADR 28/01 is in force legally but superseded for new vehicles. June 2026 Australian lighting package amends ADR 13/00 and 19/02 (new alternative pathways, new ADR 101-103), which the records predate.
